description.value: Fairway Market is a family-owned Vancouver Island grocery chain operating since 1963, now one of the largest independent grocers on the island with nine locations. The Quadra Village store is a full-service supermarket offering a wide range of departments including a deli, bakery, Asian kitchen, and sushi counter alongside standard grocery aisles. It is locally focused, stocking BC and island-produced goods and catering to diverse community tastes.
